title: fix: delay initial public community listings
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary
- Queues every new public community model or endpoint agent for 12 hours using the existing pending fields.
- Makes delete and recreate start the same publication wait, while private creation and unpublishing stay immediate.
- Shows queued values and their effective time in My Models so owners do not see stale private/zero-price form values.
- Replaces the cooldown-table approach in #13985 with no migration, tombstone, or background job.

## Tests
- `npx vitest run test/integration/community-endpoint-price-delay.test.ts test/integration/community-endpoint-policy.test.ts test/community-endpoint-rpm-input.test.ts --reporter=verbose` (23 passed)
- `npm run build:frontend --workspace pollinations-enter`
- `npm run typecheck --workspace pollinations-enter`
- `npx biome check` on all changed files

Follow-up to #13800.

gist.headline: New sprouts take twelve
gist.blurb: Fresh public community listings now spend twelve hours in the greenhouse before joining the garden. My Models shows the queued details and their opening time, so the pollen trail stays legible.
gist.summary: New public community models and endpoint agents now use the existing pending fields to queue their first publication for 12 hours, including delete-and-recreate flows, while My Models displays the queued price and effective publication time.
gist.impact: Community creators get a clear, consistent publication window for new public listings, with private creation and unpublishing still taking effect immediately.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy greenhouse-style publication queue: Polli tends small code-plants in labeled pots behind a gentle 12-hour garden timer, while a retro terminal shows pending model cards and their future publish times. The scene represents public listings getting a visible settling period before blooming into the shared community garden.
